tools.name: freshchat_get_account
tools.description: Get the Freshchat account configuration for the connected account. Good first call to confirm the connection. Freshchat API: GET /v2/accounts/configuration.

tools.name: freshchat_list_users
tools.description: Find customer users. The API needs at least one filter: first_name, last_name, email, reference_id or phone_no. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users.

tools.name: freshchat_get_user
tools.description: Get one customer user by id, with e-mail, name, phone and custom properties. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users/{user_id}.

tools.name: freshchat_list_user_conversations
tools.description: List the conversation ids of one customer user. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users/{user_id}/conversations.

tools.name: freshchat_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: assignment, status, channel, users and properties. Freshchat API: GET /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: freshchat_list_messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, oldest first. Use from_time to read only newer messages. Freshchat API: GET /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

tools.name: freshchat_send_message
tools.description: Send a plain-text agent reply into a conversation. The customer sees it at once. Freshchat API: POST /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

tools.name: freshchat_list_agents
tools.description: List support agents, with their groups, roles and availability. Freshchat API: GET /v2/agents.

tools.name: freshchat_list_groups
tools.description: List agent groups (teams that conversations are assigned to). Freshchat API: GET /v2/groups.

tools.name: freshchat_list_channels
tools.description: List channels (topics) that new conversations are created under. Freshchat API: GET /v2/channels.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: freshchat_list_users, freshchat_list_messages · Public sink: freshchat_list_users, freshchat_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: freshchat_list_users, freshchat_list_messages · Public sink: freshchat_list_users, freshchat_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
